# S12 motion CPU twin. Each case has 15 tokens:
#   name cur_cx cur_cy cur_w prev_cx prev_cy prev_w cur_jx cur_jy prev_jx prev_jy
#        history_valid instance_valid expected_uv_x expected_uv_y
# NDC is clip.xy / w minus the matching jitter; motion is the UV displacement with
# positive X right and positive Y down. Invalid history, a new/re-used instance and an
# unusable projection write zero.
